dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: High-rate geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward a sharply pointed posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical bulge located on the right lateral margin near the anterior-mid section; the left margin exhibits a more uniform and consistent curvature.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high-intensity reflectance and a subtle blueish ambient tint from water/light conditions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Sparse distribution of small, high-contrast dark punctate marks across the posterior dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent longitudinal topographical indentation on the right side of the dorsal axis, producing a visible shadow-cast region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A faint, transverse linear crease or indentation is visible across the mid-dorsal plane.
